scope: Nine benchmark candidates; fresh independent primary-text checks, not entire-project corpus
access_rule: Full text available does not mean full publication exhaustively reviewed. Parent-supplied findings remain separately attributed. No fresh visual inspection achieved.

sources.title: Research on the Thermal Calculaion Model of High Strength Aluminum Strip Rolling Based on Finite Diffreence Method
sources.version: 2015 publisher article, IJHT 33(1), pp. 91-98; HTML representation
sources.fresh_access_detail: Primary publisher full HTML read through model, Tables 1-2 and discussion. PDF download failed via shell network; no fresh visual PDF check.
sources.findings: Three-pass AA5052 force/slip observations provide a conditional replay target. Published material coefficient and friction inputs can anchor a declared adapter.
weaknesses_conflicts: Initial history, Eq. 3 weight, strain/stress mapping and speed reference unresolved
Table 1 radius versus Eq. 6 diameter wording
Friction independence and sensor uncertainty unestablished
No measured thermal validation
sources.domain: AA5052 cold single-strip rolling, 4.10 to 1.72 mm; unknown incoming temper
sources.evidence_level: Primary article with measured force/slip; incomplete boundary and material identification
sources.relevance: First conditional experiment; not independent validation or foil evidence

sources.title: Comparison of Simplified and Finite Element Analysis on Cold Flat Rolling
sources.version: Published 2020 article, Materials Science and Engineering 45(1), pp. 271-283; institutional repository PDF
sources.fresh_access_detail: Primary 13-page PDF text: experimental setup, complete Table 3, Eqs. 18-20 and FE assumptions examined. Screenshot reference returned without visible image.
sources.findings: Exact measured three-pass force/torque table; independently verified in companion review.
weaknesses_conflicts: Friction inferred from the loads being compared
Unknown experimental tension and torque convention
Missing initial hardening and constitutive reference values
20°C interpass reset is a model assumption
sources.domain: Aluminium composition specified, alloy designation unresolved; hot-rolled entry followed by cold passes
sources.evidence_level: Primary measured chain, reproduction incomplete and friction not independent

sources.title: Investigation of Tribological Conditions for Cold Rolling of Aluminum
sources.version: Published 2020 article, Materials Science and Engineering 45(1), pp. 284-294; institutional repository PDF
sources.fresh_access_detail: 11-page primary PDF text; setup, Eq. 1, nominal Table 2 and inverse fitting read. Figure 4 image not freshly inspected.
sources.findings: AA5754 annealed strip with explicit tension forces and two speeds; measured force/torque used to fit friction.
weaknesses_conflicts: Actual gauges differ from nominal schedule; mapping to graph reductions unresolved
Friction factor is not automatically Coulomb coefficient
Parent reports suspicious N force-axis label; inherited visual evidence, not freshly verified
sources.domain: AA5754 cold strip; lubricant comparison and surface failure
sources.relevance: Lubrication/surface-quality study and future data request, not current benchmark fixture

sources.title: Vertical Vibration Model for Unsteady Lubrication in Rolls-Strip Interface of Cold Rolling Mills
sources.fresh_access_detail: Full publisher HTML available; Section 3 Tables 1-2 and vibration discussion examined. Some equations lacked alternative text.
sources.findings: AA3102 chain 6→3.5→2→1.1 mm; measured force 440/485/400 in reported t units, width 760 mm. Tension and speed given as ranges.
weaknesses_conflicts: No per-pass mapping of speed/tension ranges
Resolve tonne-force versus mass notation and kg/mm² stress convention
207 GPa modulus must be assigned to the correct body, not copied as aluminium modulus
Missing initial material history and observation uncertainty
sources.domain: AA3102 cold rolling and mill vibration
sources.evidence_level: Primary industrial force comparison with incomplete inputs
sources.relevance: Weaker force reserve; future lubrication/dynamics architecture source

sources.title: Investigation of steady state rolling and evaluation of rolling force and friction in cold rolling of aluminum
sources.version: 2011 Eriksson and Waltersson thesis, identity inherited from parent audit; not freshly verified from full text
sources.fresh_access_detail: Official PDF timed out through web and Exa; institutional record returned anti-bot page. No bypass attempted.
pages_equations_tables: Parent-reported Fig. 11 and Appendices 3-10; not independently reread
sources.findings: Inherited parent finding: repeated 1.55 mm entry single-pass experiments, not a chained multipass history. No new source-content claim.
weaknesses_conflicts: Fresh access gap; source metadata and inherited exclusions need later verification
Do not infer chain continuity from a sweep of reductions
sources.domain: Aluminium cold-rolling experimental sweep, inherited classification
sources.evidence_level: Parent-reviewed primary thesis; fresh reviewer has inaccessible content
sources.relevance: Potential separate force/slip experimental matrix after access; not admitted as multipass case

sources.title: Models for symmetric cold rolling of an aluminum sheet
sources.version: Published 2022 article, author-deposited full text uploaded 2022-12-18; pp. 4-18
sources.fresh_access_detail: Primary author-uploaded full text; pp. 5-8 and strain/model comparison sections read. DOI and institution links failed fresh opening; author upload identified explicitly.
sources.findings: AA1050 after 550°C/3 min treatment; measured tensile fit, single 2→1.4 mm pass, R=75 mm and angular speed 1.1023 rad/s. Deformation-line comparison estimates friction.
weaknesses_conflicts: Friction fitted to the same deformation pattern; fitted observations not independent validation
FLM parameter p is not directly Coulomb mu
Single-pass field study, not multipass force/torque chain
sources.domain: AA1050 symmetric cold rolling; through-thickness deformation
sources.evidence_level: Primary tensile characterization and measured deformation pattern
sources.relevance: Useful complementary strain-field test after explicit observation/fit partition

sources.title: Cold-rolling mill: modelling of the rolling process and characterization of the evolving properties
sources.version: 2018 University of Johannesburg DPhil thesis, institution record 9911218107691; not assumed identical to companion journal article
sources.fresh_access_detail: Institution record and official PDF text extracted through Exa; 412743-character extraction. Setup, material tables and load-validation section inspected, not cover-to-cover reading or figure digitization.
sources.findings: Four-pass AA8015 history 7→4.5→3.4→2.4→1.64 mm with separate per-entry stress/plastic-strain curves. Industrial force comparison discussed.
weaknesses_conflicts: 120/70°C entry temperatures versus 25°C boundary text
Friction transfer from AA6060-T5
Table 4-25 predicted values conflict with MN/kNm headings; not measured outputs
Experimental tensions and raw measured force table unresolved
Separate zero-origin material curves cannot silently become one accumulated-state law
sources.domain: AA8015 industrial cold rolling; coupled thermal/contact FE and material characterization
sources.evidence_level: Primary thesis with material characterization and graphical measured force comparison; incomplete reproduction
sources.relevance: Thermal/history reserve; not drop-in current scalar-law validation

sources.title: Experimental analysis of the aluminum cold rolling production process: A case study on the 1050 H0 alloy
sources.version: Published 2023 article, New Materials, Compounds and Applications 7(2), pp. 111-121
sources.fresh_access_detail: Primary PDF text reviewed through process, product requirements and conclusions; embedded graphical gauge sequence not freshly visually read.
sources.findings: Reported coil-processing sequence includes deformation, annealing and finishing; target product gauge 0.30 mm. Parent transcribed six-pass plot retained separately, not relabelled a fresh extraction.
weaknesses_conflicts: No complete mechanical load benchmark or per-pass rolling settings
Gauge tolerance aim is not sensor uncertainty
Broad claims that cold rolling lacks friction/heating and its temper explanations are unreliable; do not use as constitutive physics
Parent-reported final-width conflict remains unverified visually here
sources.domain: 1050 industrial process topology and final product checks
sources.evidence_level: Primary process description; weak quantitative mechanics evidence
sources.relevance: Topology/finishing requirements only; no load calibration or annealing kinetics

sources.title: Dislocation density–based constitutive modeling and experimental validation of cold-rolled AA1050 aluminum with a techno-economic assessment for lithium-ion battery applications
sources.version: Publisher article published 2026-06-24; HTML text as accessed, correction/version status not independently established
sources.fresh_access_detail: Primary full HTML obtained through Exa after intermittent browser cookie redirect; constitutive/setup, experimental XRD and data-availability sections read. Embedded tables/figures not visually checked.
sources.findings: Dislocation-density model in ABAQUS/Explicit; experiments compare XRD at 20%/40% reductions, not measured rolling loads. Dataset available only on request.
weaknesses_conflicts: CPS4R plane-stress approximation differs from wide-strip plane-strain baseline
Constitutive equation transcription requires dimensional verification before implementation
XRD agreement cannot validate force/torque, schedule safety, economic gains or foil transfer
sources.domain: AA1050 cold rolling, microstructure and economic scenario
sources.evidence_level: Primary microstructure comparison; no verified open measured load-chain dataset
sources.relevance: Later microstructure state-model candidate, not replacement load benchmark
